faq_heading: Homes near Brooke Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Brooke Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Brooke Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Brooke Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Brooke Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Devon Gardens Elementary (0.8 km east), Annieville Elementary (1.4 km north-east) and Home Quest (1.4 km north-east).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Brooke Elementary

19 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Brooke Elementary in a straight line (12 elementary, 5 secondary, 2 other; 1 independent). The closest is Devon Gardens Elementary, 0.8 km away, and the farthest on this list is Kirkbride Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Sands Secondary (1.6 km); the nearest independent school is Immaculate Conception School (2.4 km). Other elementary schools close by: Devon Gardens Elementary (0.8 km east), Annieville Elementary (1.4 km north-east), Richardson Elementary (1.5 km south-east), Gibson Elementary (1.5 km east), Gray Elementary (1.6 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Devon Gardens Elementary, 0.8 km east of Brooke Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Brooke Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Delta school finder. A home a few blocks from Brooke Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Brooke Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Look at Devon Gardens Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.8 km east of Brooke Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
